landing.contextTitle: Kuva mu mirima y'u Rwanda kugeza ku isuzuma ry'ako kanya
landing.contextText1: Indwara z'ibihingwa zishobora kurimbura umusaruro w'igihembwe cyose mbere y'uko umuhinzi agera ku mpuguke. Agri AI icyemura icyo kibazo— ifoto yafatiwe mu murima iba isuzuma mu masegonda, rikazasuzumwa n'agoronome uzi neza imiterere  yagace uherereyemo.
landing.contextText2: Buri cyitegererezo gifite amakuru y'ikirere k'aho uherereye: imvura, n'ubushyuhe bw'ikirere — kugira ngo ikemezo cya agronome gihuzwe nuburwayi bwibihingwa byawe.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Iyandikishe ukoresheje kode uhabwa na koperative yawe, utangire kumenya indwara uyu munsi.
landing.madeIn: Byubatswe ku bahinzi bo mu Rwanda

notices.requestPhotosBody: Kugira ngo twemeze isuzuma ryawe, nyamuneka wohereze amafoto 2-3 y'igihingwa kigarijwe n'indwara: ifoto y'amababi yaremwe hafi, n'ifoto yerekana igihingwa cyose. Fungura isuzuma mu kice 'Isuzuma Zanjye' hanyuma ukande 'Ongeraho ifoto'.
